human_supply_role: AI-frozen new task family with mandatory audit layer; explicitly NOT user supply and NOT engine-generated discovery
family_semantics: A delay-equivalent pair differs only in arrival round. A race against a declared partner collapses the arrival distinction into a value distinction (truncation step). A downstream process declared up front completes only when the delivered value carries the original producer's witness.

grammar.negative_control_policy: choose the least declared horizon at or above both finite input indices; if none exists, report CONTROL_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_GRAMMAR

reduction_guard.reason: The bind is the declared downstream process and downstream_guard is its witness-sensitive branch; reduction must keep the task-declared consumer shape. Every parameter change is rechecked for grammar membership and separation.

out_of_envelope_declaration.proof_method: within_grammar_witness of any witness binding these continuations against l1-v0/v1/v2 returns false with reason BIND_CONTINUATION

grammar.declared_bounds_note: Complete enumeration of the finite constructor product: atoms = 1 + 2*(delay_index_max+1); contexts = non-empty well-typed op sequences up to context_depth_max; denominator is finite and closed.

disjointness_from_existing_15_grammars.proof_method: within_grammar_witness membership check against every existing declared grammar
